        zs_observe.delhivery_settlement dset
    WHERE
        dset.group_level_id = '22'
        AND dset.is_active = true
        AND dset.payment_mode = 'COD'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT DISTINCT
        'DTDC' AS courier_name, -- Inferred from table context
        tdset.payment_mode AS remittance_type
    FROM
        zs_observe.dtdc_settlement tdset
    WHERE
        tdset.group_level_id = '22'
